To: Elizabeth Horne
Cc: Jennifer Vasquez, David Sherman
That clears the last open item on the data side, and we can proceed. With the status codes defined, the census for the Howard and Sons plan is complete and reconciled.

When the asset statement reaches us, I will reconcile it against the plan's records, and Jennifer Vasquez will confirm the assumption set before we run the first cut of the {{fact:f:E-2016-001.client}} valuation. You will see the assumptions before any results.
